stem:
Yuvraj presses and gently scratches a rubber eraser and a steel spoon edge. Soft materials change shape or scratch easily; hard materials resist both.

Which judgement is correct?

options.text: The eraser that dents and scratches easily is soft; the steel edge that resists both is hard.
The eraser is hard because it changed shape when pressed.
He can call the steel edge soft without pressing or scratching it.
Soft and hard apply only to the steel edge, not to the rubber eraser.

teacher.key_rationale: Hardness is judged from how easily pressing or scratching changes the material. Easy change means soft; resistance means hard. Skipping the test or limiting the idea to steel alone is wrong.
